shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && find .agents -type f | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md

grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "toast\|notification" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; echo ----; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; cat src/*.tsx; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster Button 2>&1 | head -40; grep -n -i -A12 "toast" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/components/Toaster; cat build/components/Toaster/types.d.ts build/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts build/components/Toaster/ToasterProvider.d.ts build/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts build/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.d.ts 2>&1 | head -150; grep -n -i "toaster" build/components/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && cat types.d.ts index.d.ts Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts hooks/useToaster.d.ts; cat ../../toaster-singleton.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Toaster/constants.d.ts; grep -n "autoHiding\|DEFAULT" Toaster/Toast/Toast.js | head; grep -n "position\|fixed" ../../../styles/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -0; cd /home/sandbox/workspace; ls src; cat .gitignore
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -A25 '"exports"' package.json | head -50; grep -rn "toaster-singleton" build/esm/*.d.ts | head
